summary: Workflow YAML is well-structured (pinned actions, proper permissions, job dependencies), but PowerShell script lacks Set-StrictMode and input validation—best practices present but incomplete. Code is tight with no dead code. Clear naming and good comments throughout. However, deliverable is INCOMPLETE and non-functional: (1) Missing critical files: rules.json, fixtures/cases/*/changed-files.json, PrLabelAssigner.Tests.ps1, .actrc; test harness will fail immediately with 'no fixture cases found'. (2) Workflow doesn't support real PRs—only works with pre-generated fixtures; doesn't read changed files from GitHub API context. (3) Output parsing in bash harness is fragile (grep pattern dependent on exact format). Untestable as-is; cannot run 'act' without fixture setup.
